This role contributes to the overall strategy of the business and works with the MNISS team on complex issues.
cond_0639.responsibilities:
Coordinate a global, cross-business team primarily focused on the Mechanical Nuclear Island Support Systems (Process, Radiation and Environmental Monitoring System, Outage Management and Tooling System, Offgas System, Containment System, and Containment Inerting System). Work alongside the team to provide leadership, resources, and training needed to ensure high quality deliverables in accordance with customer requirements, business procedures, and regulatory agency guidelines. Shared responsibilities include:
Delivering cohesive, high quality technical solutions to internal and external customers in an on-time manner, in coordination with cross-functional partners.
Supporting the development, maintenance, application, and improvement of design and analysis processes (including procedures).
Contributing to business growth initiatives alongside relevant stakeholders.
Helping develop innovative technical solutions for the [Product name masked] by staying current in industry trends, partnering with stakeholders, and leveraging industry relationships.
Supporting the development of technical talent and depth within the organization by fostering a positive learning environment through coaching and mentoring.
cond_0639.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in mechanical, nuclear, or similar engineering discipline.
Minimum 6 years of experience in an engineering role.
Minimum 3 years' experience as a team leader or manager.
Minimum 3 years' experience working with customers.
Technical knowledge of nuclear island mechanical systems.
Actual leadership experience and working knowledge in design, plant systems, and/or operational experience at one or more nuclear power plants.
Open communication style and proven ability to develop team relationships, including global teams.
Demonstrated ability to manage a large, matrixed team with multiple demands and priorities.
Demonstrated project management skills, including cost/schedule control and work planning/execution.
Preferred Requirements
Advanced engineering degree.
Proven ability to create positive change, think creatively, and respond rapidly to changing priorities and customer needs.
Knowledge of [Product name masked] product and customers and [Company name masked] business processes.
Demonstrated ability to establish a vision and direction for a new organization.
Eligibility Requirements
This role requires access to U.S. Export-controlled information. If applicable, final offers will be contingent on ability to obtain authorization for access to U.S. Export-controlled information from the U.S. Government.
